about: Seed assumptions for Truck Planner on smappen, model tps-0.1.0. Defined by docs/truck-planner/02_MODEL.md. Nothing here is measured from food-truck sales. Tags: measured = published by a source that was opened; derived = arithmetic on measured inputs; assumed = engineering judgement; tuned = no outside evidence, set so two sanity anchors land in range.

entry_format.value: the seed (number, string, or array). Compound entries (curves, tables) hold several named values instead and share one set of metadata.
entry_format.scope: build = baked into the region pack, changing it means rebuilding the region; fixed = runtime constant; owner = may be overridden per truck through Assumptions.overrides; profile_default = initial value of a TruckProfile field
entry_format.min_max: validation bounds for every number an override may set (inclusive). Metadata is inherited from the nearest enclosing object that defines it.
entry_format.source: short note naming the publisher or the reasoning; 'recon 10' and 'recon 09' are the session-0 reconnaissance reports of 2026-10-04 (behavioural seeds; data sources), which hold the URL of every source and are not in the repository
entry_format.override_path: dot-separated keys from the root, for example segments.w_office.intent.weekday or host.captive_share; the last key may not be one of vocabulary.structural_keys

earth_radius_m.source: IUGG mean Earth radius R1; the only radius used anywhere in the model.

pi.source: Mathematical constant; written out so no runtime constant is used.

z80.source: 0.9 quantile of the standard normal: half-width of an 80 % interval.

round_half.source: 0.5 plus a 1e-9 nudge, added before floor in round_half_away.

qkey_scale.source: Ranking keys are compared in whole millionths.

daypart_of_hour.source: breakfast 05-10, lunch 11-15, dinner 16-21, late 22-04; the 11/16/22 boundaries are those of PosSalesRepository::dayPart.

walk_decay_m.source: 2009 NHTS walking trips for meals e-fold at 649 m (Yang and Diez-Roux 2012, measured); tightened because a 35-minute lunch break caps the round trip. Sensitivity range 300-650. recon 10 s4.1

walk_cutoff_m.source: exp(-1200/400) = 5 % weight; sources beyond are ignored. recon 10 s4.1

outside_option_a0.source: Weight of 'buy elsewhere, bring lunch, give up'. A truck at the door with no rival wins 1/2.6 = 38 % of people who buy a meal that hour. Set so the office-park anchor lands near the blueprint's 66; entangled with lunch intent and walk decay. recon 10 s4.1

quick.source: One ordinary quick-service or fast-casual outlet = one truck at the same distance. recon 10 s4.1

full.source: A sit-down meal is a weaker substitute inside a 35-minute lunch break; equal in the evening. Not in recon 10.

cafe.source: Partial substitute (recon 10: coffee 0.5); most are shut or irrelevant in the evening.

bar.source: Bar food competes in the evening only. Not in recon 10.

normal.source: Reference level; the level every map cell is built at.

prominent.source: Seen from the main approach, or announced by the host. recon 10 s2

cns04_weight.unit: weight of construction jobs (LODES CNS04) in w_industrial
cns04_weight.source: LODES places construction workers at the contractor's office, not on site (165,397 of the Washington region's 390,336 industrial-segment jobs). DECISIONS s8.

cell_min_nearby.unit: distance-weighted people (sum of the nearby vector)
cell_min_nearby.source: Map cells below this are left out of the cell pack; a click there is still simulated exactly. 03_DATA.md s7.2, DECISIONS s8.

captive_share.unit: share of the venue's meal intent
captive_share.source: Truck is the venue's only food, segments with host_mode captive. Set so the taproom anchor gives 39; about 27 % of patrons order during a 1.4-hour visit. No measurement exists. recon 10 s4.1

shared_kitchen_share.unit: share of the venue's meal intent
shared_kitchen_share.source: Venue has its own kitchen: 1 / (1/0.75 + 2.0) with an assumed kitchen weight of 2.0. recon 10 s4.1

onsite_kitchen_weight.source: On-site cafeteria or kitchen as a rival at distance zero, for hosts whose segment has host_mode open. recon 10 s4.1

exclusion_radius_m.source: How far from the truck the host's declared workers or residents are looked for in the block data so they are not counted twice.

place_types.note: visitor_segment = segment of the place's own source point (null = none: its people are already in the census or jobs data, or it is handled as an event). default_size = base count of that point. rival_kind = food-outlet kind (null = not a rival). host_fit = prior that this kind of place hosts trucks; used only to rank scouting results, never in an estimate. kitchen_default = whether a place of this type is assumed to sell its own food (yes | no). host_segment = segment a host of this type declares its people in (null = not a host).

taproom.source: Average taproom is about 11-15 people at its Saturday peak (weak derivation from Arryved pint counts); trucks are hosted by larger ones; range 15-150. recon 10 s4.7

gym.source: 7,180 members per large club (Planet Fitness 2025) x 8 % visiting per day (assumed) x about 10 % of visits in the peak hour = about 57. recon 10 s4.7

park.source: Measured average of 34-42 users per observed hour in 174 neighbourhood parks, 25 US cities (PMC5289920; summariser-read), used here as the busiest-hour figure. recon 10 s3.4 #4.3

shopping_centre.source: Strip centre; a regional mall is about 1,500. No source opened. recon 10 s4.7

campus.source: Conservative default for an unnamed campus; a real figure is 0.6 x enrolment. Weak seed. recon 10 s4.7

hospital.source: 0.8 x staffed beds (guess) x 151 beds per community hospital (AHA 2026). Staff come from the jobs data. Weak seed. recon 10 s4.7

transit_station.source: Entries in the busiest hour; about 10 % of a 3,000-entry weekday. Not sourced. Weak seed.

events_venue.source: Theatre, cinema, community or conference centre. Not sourced.

stadium.source: Size 0 on the hourly map by design: use an event stop with the expected attendance. recon 10 s4.7

hotel.source: About 100 rooms x 0.6 occupancy x 1.5 guests. Not sourced.

attraction.source: Museum, zoo, theme park. Not sourced.

farmers_market.source: A market runs a few hours a week, so it has no hourly presence: use an event stop (USDA 2019: 780 households on a peak-season market day). recon 10 s4.7

office_park.source: Workers come from the jobs data, so the place has no people of its own.

apartment_community.source: Residents come from the census data; a host enters units x 2.0 (persons per unit not sourced).

industrial_site.source: Workers come from the jobs data.

car_dealership.source: 15 customers on the shopping curve; 64 staff per franchised dealership (NADA 2024) are in the jobs data. recon 10 s4.7

holidays.unit: 5 U.S.C. 6103 rules; no table, no API
holidays.source: Rules checked against OPM's published lists for 2025-2030 (recon 09 s7). The major/minor split is assumed.

rules.name: Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.

floor.source: Lowest combined weather multiplier. recon 10 s4.5

pop_when_missing.source: Used when the text names precipitation but the forecast gives no probability.

temperature_bands.unit: multiplier on walk-up demand; a band applies when temp_f < upper_f; the last band has no upper bound

below_20.source: Beyond the studied range. recon 10 s4.5

20_31.source: Beyond the studied range. recon 10 s4.5

32_39.source: Pedestrian counts +14 % per +5 C (de Montigny et al.), damped because lunch is less discretionary than a walk. recon 10 s4.5

40_49.source: Pedestrian counts +14 % per +5 C (de Montigny et al.), halved because lunch is less discretionary than a walk. recon 10 s4.5

50_59.source: Pedestrian counts +14 % per +5 C (de Montigny et al.), halved because lunch is less discretionary than a walk. recon 10 s4.5

95_up.source: Hot days reduce restaurant visits (Foursquare 2018). recon 10 s4.5

precip_classes.unit: multiplier on walk-up demand if it does precipitate; blended with the probability of precipitation
precip_classes.match_rule: ASCII-lower-case the short forecast; classes are tested in 'order'; the first class with any substring present wins; no match = dry

storm.source: Operators shut down in storms (two local news reports). recon 10 s4.5

heavy_snow.source: Snow to dry = +23 % pedestrians; 'notable decline' at restaurants. recon 10 s4.5

ice.source: Set equal to heavy snow. Not in recon 10.

light_rain.source: Indoor restaurants -1.6 % (Foursquare 2018); pedestrians -32 % on wet days; a truck has no shelter. recon 10 s4.5

rain.source: Operators report about -50 %; restaurants -7 to -11 %. recon 10 s4.5

wind_bands.unit: multiplier on walk-up demand; a band applies when wind_mph < upper_mph; the last band has no upper bound

windy.source: Nothing measured for wind. recon 10 s4.5

very_windy.source: Nothing measured for wind. recon 10 s4.5

dc.unit: travel time / free-flow travel time, rows Monday..Sunday, 24 local clock hours each
dc.source: Washington DC metro area. TomTom Traffic Index 2025, metro area, all roads: 1 + congestion level / 100 for each hour of the week (parsed from the public pages 2026-10-04). Relative to TomTom's free-flow speeds; read TomTom's terms before shipping. Source rows were Sunday-first; rotated to Monday-first here. recon 10 s6

us_mean.unit: travel time / free-flow travel time, rows Monday..Sunday, 24 local clock hours each
us_mean.source: Mean of 11 US metros (Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Washington DC, Denver, Houston, Los Angeles, Minneapolis, Phoenix, Seattle). TomTom Traffic Index 2025, metro area, all roads: 1 + congestion level / 100 for each hour of the week (parsed from the public pages 2026-10-04). Relative to TomTom's free-flow speeds; read TomTom's terms before shipping. Source rows were Sunday-first; rotated to Monday-first here. recon 10 s6

dc_typical.unit: travel time under average traffic / free-flow travel time
dc_typical.source: Mean of the matrix's 168 values, rounded to 3 decimals. Google's traffic-unaware durations are based on 'average time-independent traffic conditions' (Routes API reference, read 2026-10-04), so a Google leg is scaled by factor / this value. That Google's average equals this all-hours mean is an assumption.

us_mean_typical.unit: travel time under average traffic / free-flow travel time
us_mean_typical.source: Mean of the matrix's 168 values, rounded to 3 decimals. Google's traffic-unaware durations are based on 'average time-independent traffic conditions' (Routes API reference, read 2026-10-04), so a Google leg is scaled by factor / this value. That Google's average equals this all-hours mean is an assumption.

detour_factor.source: Typical road circuity; no source opened. Used only when no routed leg exists.

local_miles.source: First part of every leg is driven at the local speed.

local_mph.source: Streets and signals at the two ends of a leg.

trunk_mph.source: Rest of the leg. With 2 local miles a 9-mile leg averages 38 mph, TomTom's 2025 free-flow average for the Washington metro (61.1 km/h, measured).

avg_ticket.source: Blueprint default. A bought workday lunch averages $13.39 (ezCater 2025). No truck-specific measurement.

capacity_orders_per_hour.source: Blueprint default. Trade rule: 40-60 customers an hour is a successful event.

paid_crew.source: Blueprint default. Census 2018: 2.7 employees per employer truck.

wage_per_hour.source: Blueprint default. BLS median for restaurant cooks $17.98 (May 2025).

payroll_burden_pct.source: Employer payroll taxes; not sourced. Matches the blueprint's $79 for a two-hour gap.

food_cost_pct.source: Analogue: Chipotle FY2025 food, beverage and packaging 29.6 % (measured); trade 28-35 %.

packaging_per_order.source: Trade (Canada): $0.30-$0.70. Set to 0 if the food-cost figure already includes paper goods.

card_fee_pct.source: Square in-person rate, Free plan, 2.6 % + 15 cents (price list; summariser-read).

card_share.unit: fraction of sales paid by card

tips_include.source: Tips are left out of take-home unless the owner opts in.

tips_pct_of_card_sales.source: Weak: 66.6 % of card transactions tipped x about 16 % quick-service average (Toast, all venue types).

generator_gal_per_hour.source: Cummins Onan QG 7000i at half load (spec sheet); 0.9 at full load. Set to 0 on shore power.

fixed_cost_per_service_day.source: Commissary, insurance and other fixed costs spread over service days. Trade: commissary $300-$1,500 a month. Left at 0 until the owner enters it.

daypart_fit.unit: multiplier on meal intent in that daypart
daypart_fit.source: A lunch-and-dinner menu is not credited with the coffee and breakfast purchases in the curves. Assumed.

routing_profile.source: Google routes as a car (travel mode DRIVE). 'truck' is kept for a later truck-aware source; the model treats both alike and applies truck_time_factor.

truck_time_factor.source: A loaded step van accelerates and corners slower than the cars the data comes from. recon 10 s4.6

scout_drive_minutes_limit.source: Default reach for scouting, in drive minutes from the base.

fee_warn_share.source: Trade rule: try not to pay more than 10 % of sales in fees. recon 10 s3.3 #3.18

fuel_price_fallback.source: EIA weekly retail prices, regular gasoline (EPMR) and No 2 diesel (EPD2D), period 2026-09-28 (recon 09 s5). Used only when there is no owner price and no stored EIA value.

attendance_haircut.source: Trade (SoCal MFVA): festivals have delivered less than a quarter of projected attendance. recon 10 s4.3

p_buy.unit: share of attendees who buy a meal from some vendor
p_buy.source: UK trade guideline (NCASS): local fetes and carnivals 35-45 %, all-day outdoor music 75-85 %, fireworks and music evenings 25-30 %; 'incidental' assumed. recon 10 s3.3 #3.6

min_attendees_per_vendor.source: Trade rule: 200-300 attendees per truck when everyone eats, double otherwise. Below this the stop gets a warning. recon 10 s3.3

suggested_fee_pct.source: Prefill only. Trucks expect 5-10 %; 10-25 % is seen. recon 10 s4.4

sd_truck.source: Uncertainty about this truck's overall level before any log. sd_truck, sd_spot and sd_day combine to 0.47 (recon 10 prior_log_sd). The blueprint's ranges (66: 40-103; 39: 23-64) have a log half-width of about 0.47; using 0.47 as the standard deviation makes ranges before any log deliberately wider than the blueprint's. recon 10 s4.1

sd_spot.source: Uncertainty about one spot relative to the truck's level.

sd_day.source: Day-to-day variation that no amount of logging removes; replaced by the logged residual spread as logs accumulate.

sd_weak.source: Extra spread when weak-seed segments (campus, hospital, transit) supply all of the demand; scaled by their share.

sd_default_size.source: Extra spread when a host size is a place-type default (taproom default 40, plausible 15-150); scaled by the host's share of demand.

sd_event.source: Extra spread for attendance-based event estimates.

count_dispersion.source: Counting noise: orders in a window scatter more than a Poisson count.

resid_prior_weight.source: Weight of sd_day against the logged residual spread.

k_truck.source: Prior weight for the truck factor: the logs carry n/(n+4), 71 % after ten services. recon 10 s4.1

k_spot.source: Prior weight for a spot factor.

half_life_days.source: A service this old counts half.

ratio_clamp.source: Actual / predicted is limited to 1/4 .. 4 before taking logs.

min_predicted.source: Services predicted below this are not used.

min_actual.source: Zero orders are counted as half an order so the log exists.

min_resid_n.source: Residual spread is reported from this many unsold-out services.

long_gap_minutes.source: A paid gap at least this long raises a warning.

long_day_minutes.source: A day longer than this raises a warning.

early_start_minute.source: Prep starting before 05:00 raises a warning.

service_minutes.source: Length of a suggested service window. Trade: office programmes serve lunch for 3 hours.

latest_close_minute.source: No suggested window closes after midnight.

windows_per_spot.source: Candidate windows per spot per day.

max_candidates.source: Candidates kept per day before combining.

max_stops_per_day.source: Default; a request may ask for 1 to 3.

max_day_minutes.source: Days longer than 14 hours are not suggested.

min_stop_orders.source: Windows expected below this are not candidates.

week_day_options.source: Day plans considered per day by suggest_week.

max_days_per_week.source: Default; a request may ask for 1 to 7.

max_visits_per_spot_per_week.source: Default weekly frequency limit per spot; a request may ask for 1 to 7.

min_day_take_home.source: A day is suggested only if its expected take-home is above this.
